description: Starts a one-time purchase and returns a Stripe Checkout link for the person who pays, plus a status_url to poll. product: credits_1k ($10), credits_10k ($79), city_pack ($29, needs place) or compliance_list ($99, one whole compliance list as CSV, needs list). The person must agree to the data-use terms (no screening or profiling people): pass agree_data_use=true only after they have.

agree_data_use.description: True once the person accepts: no tenant, employment, credit or insurance screening, and no locating or profiling anyone.

email.description: Email of the person paying. Receipts and the account go there.

list.description: For compliance_list: a list id from list_compliance, e.g. sb721-cited.

personhood.description: Optional 5arz proof-of-personhood credential (pop_jwt) showing a verified human stands behind this agent. Recorded with the order.

place.description: For city_pack: a place id, e.g. us-ca-los-angeles.

name: buy
title: Buy credits or a city data pack
